configuration.title: Review thresholds
configuration.subtitle: Adjust the criteria used to review and protect reports.

fields.flag_auto_hide_threshold: Flags required to hide a report

help.flag_auto_hide_threshold: Flags from distinct origins that trigger review.
help.duplicate_radius_meters: Maximum distance for suggesting a potential duplicate.
help.duplicate_time_window_minutes: Maximum time between possible duplicate reports.
help.trust_medium_threshold: Must be lower than the high trust threshold.
help.gps_accuracy_max_meters: Less accurate positions require report review.
help.report_rate_limit_per_hour: Maximum new reports per origin in one hour.
help.flag_rate_limit_per_hour: Maximum flags per origin in one hour.

configuration.reasonHelp: Required. Explain why you are publishing this configuration.
configuration.reasonPlaceholder: For example: adjust the distance after reviewing nearby reports.
configuration.saveExplanation: Saving publishes a new version. The previous configuration remains in history.
configuration.fixFields: Check the highlighted fields before saving.
configuration.sessionBody: You need a current Administrator session to view and change these values.
configuration.forbiddenBody: Only an active Administrator account can manage thresholds.
configuration.verifyBeforeRetry: Publication could not be confirmed. Check the active version before saving again to avoid creating an extra version by mistake.
configuration.discardBody: Your edits to this form will be lost. The published configuration will not change.

validation.integer: Must be a whole number without decimal places.
validation.precision: Use no more than {{decimals}} decimal places.
validation.trustOrder: Must be lower than the high trust threshold.
validation.note: Enter a nonblank reason with 1–1000 characters.

errors.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.configuration_unavailable: No active configuration is available. Ask the technical team to check the environment.
errors.preflight_mismatch: The server environment requires technical review.
errors.invalid_response: The server did not return a valid configuration. Reload the values.
errors.invalid_request: Check the values and the reason for the change.
errors.configuration_conflict: Configuration changed during publication. Check the active version.

zoneSets.title: Zone map
zoneSets.subtitle: Prepare a map version, then activate it after Association approval.
zoneSets.noActive: There is no active zone in this environment.
zoneSets.stepOneHelp: Select a file or paste its content. Saving creates a new version and keeps the current active zone.
zoneSets.fileHelp: A direct Polygon or MultiPolygon in WGS84 (longitude, latitude). Maximum 1 MiB. For a Feature or FeatureCollection, first export the reviewed geometry.
zoneSets.checksumHelp: Calculated from the normalized geometry stored by the server. Whitespace and key order do not change this fingerprint. The server also validates the geometry.
zoneSets.created: Draft saved. Uploading alone does not activate the zone.
zoneSets.waitForDraft: This step becomes available after the server confirms the draft was saved.
zoneSets.approvalHelp: The Asociación de Hoteles de Chihuahua must approve this version and checksum outside the app. Enter the evidence reference; this field does not replace approval.
zoneSets.replaceHelp: Activating this version retires the previous active zone. Its data and history are preserved.
zoneSets.activated: Activation confirmed. This version is active.

uncertain.create: The draft could not be confirmed as saved. It will not be sent again automatically. Before creating another draft, ask the operator to check the operation record; there is no draft lookup to recover it here yet.
uncertain.activate: Activation could not be confirmed. Check the active zone before continuing. This operation will not be retried automatically.

zoneSets.notConfirmed: The current active zone does not match this draft. Keep its ID and ask the operator to verify its status before another activation attempt.
zoneSets.leaveSaved: The saved draft stays on the server, but this screen cannot retrieve drafts when you return yet. Keep its ID for an operator to review. A pending operation may have completed.

validation.empty: Select a file or paste GeoJSON.
validation.size: The content exceeds the 1 MiB limit.
validation.json: The content is not valid JSON.
validation.geometry: Use a nonempty Polygon or MultiPolygon with only type and coordinates.
validation.ring: Each ring needs at least four positions and must end at its starting position.
validation.position: Each position must contain longitude from −180 to 180 and latitude from −90 to 90, without a third coordinate.
validation.required: Enter 1 to {{max}} characters; it cannot be blank.
validation.uri: Enter an absolute source URI, such as https://…
validation.prepare: Calculate the checksum of the current content before saving.
validation.approval: Enter an approval reference of 1 to 1000 characters.

errors.request_failed: The operation could not be completed. Check your connection and the displayed status.
errors.invalid_request: The server rejected the data. Check the fields and geometry validity.
errors.zone_set_conflict: The draft cannot be activated or a concurrent change occurred. Check its status.
errors.not_found: The draft was not found in this environment.
errors.preflight_mismatch: The service environment is not ready for this operation.
errors.invalid_response: The response cannot confirm the zone version.
errors.checksum_unavailable: The checksum could not be calculated. Prepare the content again.
